blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Validating industrial oxy-combustion burner designs traditionally requires costly experimental campaigns in which each operating condition is physically reproduced on an instrumented rig and imaged via OH* chemiluminescence, rendering iterative design exploration prohibitively slow. This work develops deep generative surrogate models that map a 15-dimensional vector of continuous operating parameters (thermal power, swirl numbers, momentum ratios, mixture fractions, etc.) directly to a $512\times64$ heat-release flame image, trained on 1,609 experimental samples from the OXYTEC dual-swirl non-premixed oxy-combustion database. Two complementary generative paradigms are investigated, as they offer opposite strengths for surrogate modelling: a custom spatially-anchored conditional least-squares GAN (cLSGAN-L1-CBN), whose single-pass generation enables near-instantaneous inference, and a custom physics-guided denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM), whose iterative sampling favours the smooth, continuous heat-release gradients of fluid flows. Both are validated through ablation on a stratified held-out test set. The optimized cLSGAN reaches RMSE 0.022 and FID 20.68 and generates an image in about 20 ms on a mobile workstation GPU, though extended training leaves its texture realism unchanged; the DDPM improves steadily over long training horizons, reaching RMSE 0.019 and FID 20.29 at 40,000 epochs, at the cost of roughly thirty seconds per image on the same hardware --- three orders of magnitude slower than the adversarial surrogate. A nearest-neighbour analysis traces the persistent worst-case errors to sparsely sampled regions of the parameter space, and a parameter-sensitivity study confirms smooth, physically consistent responses to perturbed inputs. These results demonstrate that carefully guided generative models can act as reliable visual surrogates for combustion experiments.
blocks.zh: 验证工业用氧燃烧燃烧器的设计,传统上需要成本高昂的实验运动,在这种试验活动中,每个操作条件都实际复制在一台仪器钻机上,并通过OH* 化学发光仪进行成像,使得迭代设计勘探的速度极其缓慢。 这项工作开发出深源代活性模型,将连续操作参数的15维向量(热能,回旋数,动能比,混合物分数等)直接映射到512\times64美元放热放出火焰图像上,从OXYTEC双向回旋非预混合氧燃烧数据库培养出1,609个实验样本. 研究了两个互补的基因模型,因为它们为替代模型提供了相反的优势:一个定制的空间定位条件最低平方GAN(cLSGAN-L1-CBN),其单行道生成可以近乎瞬间推论;一个定制的物理导解扩散概率模型(DDPM),其迭代取样有利于流体流平滑而连续的放热梯度. 两者均通过分级搁置的测试集进行验证。 被优化的cLSGAN达到RMSE 0.022和FID 20.68,并在移动工作站GPU上生成了约20ms的图像,虽然扩展培训使其纹理现实主义保持不变;DDPM在长时间的训练地平线上稳步改善,在40,000个历程上达到RMSE 0.019和FID 20.29,在同一硬件上每幅图像花费约30秒 -- -- 三个数量级比对抗代位慢. 最近的邻里分析将持续存在的最坏情况误差追溯到对参数空间的稀有采样区域,参数灵敏度研究确认了对扰动输入的平稳而物理上一致的反应. 这些结果表明,仔细地被引导的基因模型可以作为燃烧实验的可靠视觉代用.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Heavy industries such as glass manufacturing and metallurgy increasingly rely on oxy-combustion, in which pure oxygen replaces atmospheric air as the oxidizer [ 1 ] . Eliminating the nitrogen ballast raises the adiabatic flame temperature and radiative heat transfer, increases the furnace efficiency, reduces flue gas volumes by 70–80%, and yields a nearly pure CO 2 /H 2 O exhaust stream compatible with carbon capture [ 1 , 4 ] . These benefits come with extreme physical constraints: local temperatures can exceed 2500 ∘ C, and macroscopic flame characteristics—such as axial length [ 5 ] , radial expansion, and lift-off height [ 6 ] —can directly impact process safety and furnace lifetime (burner degradation, risk of flashback or flame blow-out [ 2 ] ), as well as process efficiency, pollutant emissions —like nitrogen oxides (NOx)— and product quality [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 玻璃制造和冶金等重工业日益依赖氧-燃烧,其中纯氧取代大气空气为氧化剂 [1]. 消除氮压载会提高活性火焰温度和辐射性热能转移,提高炉子效率,将烟道气体体积减少70-80%,并产生与碳捕获相匹配的近纯CO 2/H 2 O排气流[1,4]. 这些好处伴随着极端的物理限制:局部温度可超过2500 QC;宏观火焰特性——如轴长[5]、射线扩张和起落高度[6]——可直接影响工艺安全和炉活性(燃烧降解、闪回或喷出火焰的风险[2]),以及工艺效率、污染物排放——如氮氧化物——和产品质量[1]。

blocks.en: Developing burners that control these phenomena requires accounting for more than ten tightly coupled operating variables (thermal power, fuel/oxidizer flow rates, momentum ratios, swirl numbers, etc.), either through expensive numerical simulations or through full-scale experimental trials of successive burner designs [ 1 , 5 ] . A common diagnostic collects the OH* chemiluminescence emission from the flame, a good marker of the maximal heat release location [ 3 ] . A single campaign consumes days of facility time and large quantities of pure oxygen, making iterative design exploration effectively impossible.
blocks.zh: 开发能控制这些现象的燃烧器,需要通过昂贵的数值模拟或通过对相继燃烧器设计的全面试验[1,5],计算出十多个紧密结合的操作变量(热能,燃料/氧化剂流量率,动力比,旋数等). 常见的诊断收集了从火焰中释放出OH*化学发光量,这是最大放热位置的好标记[3]. 一次运动消耗了几天的设施时间和大量的纯氧,使得迭代设计探索实际上是不可能的.

blocks.en: This paper addresses that bottleneck with an AI-based predictive approach: a model trained on an existing experimental dataset of 1,609 OH* 2D fields predicts the flame shape for a new set of parameters. The approach can be seen as a cross-modal continuous regression problem: learn a mapping from the tabular operating vector 𝐱 ∈ ℝ 15 \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{15} to the spatial OH* emission field 𝐘 ∈ ℝ 512 × 64 × 1 \mathbf{Y}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 64\times 1} . This enables an engineer to obtain physically accurate flame images interactively, bypassing the days-long bottlenecks of traditional methods. The central challenge is data scarcity: although 1,609 experimental samples is an uncommonly large database, it remains orders of magnitude below the regimes modern generative models were designed for, while the underlying physics exhibits sharp non-linearities such as vortex-breakdown bifurcations, where a 2% change in swirl number can abruptly transform an attached jet flame into a lifted toroidal structure [ 2 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 本文用基于AI的预测方法解决了这个瓶颈:一个在1,609 OH* 2D字段的现有实验数据集上经过培训的模型预测出新一组参数的火焰形状. 这个方法可以看作是一个跨模式的连续回归问题:从表格操作向量 x\\R 15\ mathbf{x\\in\ mathbb{R}到空间OH*排放场 Y\R 512×64\ 1\ mathbf{Y\\in\mathbb{R\\512\times 64\times 1] (英语). 这使一名工程师能够通过交互方式获得物理准确的火焰图像,绕过传统方法长达数天的瓶颈. 中心挑战是数据稀缺:虽然1 609个实验样本是一个不寻常的大型数据库,但它仍然低于现代基因模型所设计的系统,而基础物理学显示出尖锐的非线性,如涡流分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解

blocks.en: The contributions are twofold. First, a spatially-anchored conditional least-squares GAN (cLSGAN-L1-CBN) [ 8 ] is engineered through a sequence of targeted interventions—early spatial conditioning, a projection discriminator for continuous labels [ 11 ] , conditional batch normalization [ 10 ] , an L1 geometric anchor [ 13 ] , and autonomous dynamic loss balancing in the spirit of adaptive multi-task weighting—that jointly resolve the perception–distortion trade-off between geometric accuracy and texture realism. Second, a physics-guided denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) [ 15 ] is adapted to sparse chemiluminescence images via a luminance-weighted reconstruction objective, CoordConv coordinate channels [ 14 ] , Polyak-averaged weights, and a truncated-inference sampling loop. Both paradigms are validated with a common multi-metric protocol (RMSE, PSNR, SSIM, FID) on a stratified test set, and their scaling behaviour is compared on a merged training corpus.
blocks.zh: 捐款有两方面。 首先,通过一系列有针对性的干预措施——早期空间调节、持续标签的投影歧义[11]、有条件的批量正常化[10]、L1几何锚地[13],以及本着适应性多任务权重的精神——共同解决几何精确度和纹理现实性之间的感知-扭曲取舍——来设计一个空间受干扰的有条件最小方块GAN(cLSGAN-L1-CBN)[8]。 第二,通过一个光亮加权重建目标、CoordConv协调通道[14]、Polyak平均重量和短推-推论取样回路,对少量化学发光图像进行了调整。 两种范式都通过一个分级测试集上的通用多计量协议(RMSE,PSNR,SSIM,FID)进行验证,它们的缩放行为被比较在一个合并的训练馆上.

blocks.en: 2. Experimental Dataset and Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 2. 实验数据集和问题的制定

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Origin and Acquisition
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据来源和获取

blocks.en: The dataset originates from the Air Liquide, CentraleSupelec and CNRS Chair on oxy-combustion and heat transfer for energy and environment and the OXYTEC project (ANR-12-CHIN-0001) from l’Agence Nationale de la Recherche [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . All samples correspond to a dual-swirl non-premixed configuration produced by a coaxial injector: a central tube ( d 1 = 6 d_{1}=6 mm) carries nitrogen-diluted methane, while an annular channel ( d 2 = 20 d_{2}=20 mm) carries O 2 -enriched air. Swirl is imposed on the inner jet by an axial swirler and on the annular jet by splitting the flow between axial and tangential inlets; a schematic of the test rig is given in Fig. 2 . Flames are stabilized in a 150 × 150 × 250 150\times 150\times 250 mm quartz-walled chamber, and reaction zones are imaged by OH* chemiluminescence using a 16-bit intensified CCD camera (Princeton PIMAX4) with a UV lens and a 310 nm narrowband filter. Figure 2 illustrates the diversity of flame topologies spanned by the database across the momentum flux ratio J J and the outer swirl number S 2 S_{2} , whose stabilization mechanisms are analysed in [ 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集取自国家研究署关于用于能源和环境的氧燃烧和热转移的空气液体、CentroleSupelec和CNRS主席以及OXYTEC项目(ANR-12-CHIN-0001)[4、5、6]。 所有样品都对应由同轴注射器产生的双旋非前相构型: 中央管(d 1 = 6 d_{1}=6 mm)携带被氮稀释的甲烷,而废气道(d 2 = 20 d_{2}=20 mm)携带O 2-浓缩空气. 轴旋式喷气机由轴旋式喷气机对内置喷气机和废气相接式喷气机进行分流;试验钻机的图示用法格语给出。 2 (中文(简体) ). 火焰被稳定在一个150×150×250相150相150相150相150相150相150相250相250毫米的石英-壁舱中,反应区由OH*化学发光所成像,使用16位强化CCD相机(Princeton PIMAX4)并配有紫外镜和310nm窄带滤波器. 图2显示数据库跨越动力通量比J J和外旋号S2 S_{2}的火焰地貌多样性,其稳定机制在[6,7]中作了分析。

blocks.en: 2.2 Preprocessing and Splitting
blocks.zh: 2.2 预处理和拆分

blocks.en: Exploiting axial symmetry, the raw captures are cropped, aligned to the burner lip, and standardized to 512 × 64 512\times 64 grayscale half-flame tensors normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . The 15 tabular features are standard-scaled to zero mean and unit variance. Because extreme aerodynamic events (pronounced lift-off, widened flames) are rare but industrially critical, the two Otsu metrics are discretized into five bins each to form a stratification proxy, and the 1,609 samples are split 60/20/20 into training, validation, and test sets with balanced topological coverage. All models are implemented in TensorFlow 2.10/Keras and trained on a single mobile workstation GPU (NVIDIA RTX 3500 Ada, 12 GB VRAM).

blocks.en: 3. Paradigm 1: Spatially-Anchored Conditional LSGAN (cLSGAN-L1-CBN)

blocks.en: Standard conditional GANs [ 8 ] are designed for categorical labels; conditioning on continuous regression labels risks empirical-risk-minimization collapse, since virtually no training image exists at any exact coordinate of the 15-dimensional space [ 9 ] . Throughout this section, 𝐱 ∈ ℝ 512 × 64 × 1 \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 64\times 1} denotes a flame image and 𝐲 ∈ ℝ 15 \mathbf{y}\in\mathbb{R}^{15} the standardized vector of operating parameters conditioning its generation. The architecture combines four interventions.

Projection discriminator. Instead of tiling conditions into the image grid on the discriminator side, the image is compressed by strided 4 × 4 4\times 4 convolutions and global average pooling into a feature vector ϕ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ∈ ℝ d \phi(\mathbf{x})\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , while the physical vector 𝐲 \mathbf{y} is linearly embedded into the same space through V ∈ ℝ d × 15 V\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times 15} . The conditional score is the inner product of the two, added to an unconditional realism score [ 11 ] : D ⁡ ( 𝐱 , 𝐲 ) = Dense uncond ​ ( ϕ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ) + ⟨ ϕ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) , V ​ 𝐲 ⟩ , D(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=\mathrm{Dense}_{\mathrm{uncond}}\!\big(\phi(\mathbf{x})\big)+\big\langle\,\phi(\mathbf{x}),\,V\mathbf{y}\,\big\rangle, (1) which strongly penalizes topologies inconsistent with the requested thermodynamics.

blocks.en: Although the anchored GAN delivers instantaneous inference, its single-step generation struggles to reproduce the smooth scalar gradients of a fluid manifold. DDPMs [ 15 ] replace the single-step mapping with an iterative reverse Markov chain, a strong inductive bias for spatial continuity. The forward process uses T = 1 ​ k T=1k steps with a linear variance schedule ( β start = 10 − 4 \beta_{\mathrm{start}}=10^{-4} , β end = 0.02 \beta_{\mathrm{end}}=0.02 ), and, writing α t = 1 − β t \alpha_{t}=1-\beta_{t} and α ¯ t = ∏ s ≤ t α s \bar{\alpha}_{t}=\prod_{s\leq t}\alpha_{s} , arbitrary noisy states are sampled in closed form as 𝐱 t = α ¯ t ​ 𝐱 0 + 1 − α ¯ t ​ ϵ \mathbf{x}_{t}=\sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_{t}}\,\mathbf{x}_{0}+\sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}_{t}}\,\boldsymbol{\epsilon} , where ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) \boldsymbol{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) . The reverse process is parameterized by a U-Net [ 16 ] with Swish activations; the timestep and the 15 physical features are embedded through independent 256-dimensional Swish blocks, fused into a 512-dimensional context vector, and injected at every resolution by affine channel addition. Four physics-oriented modifications are applied.

blocks.en: 5. Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Both paradigms are developed through an ablation study: starting from a plain conditional baseline, the physical constraints introduced in Sections 3 and 4 are added one at a time, and each intermediate model is retrained and re-evaluated under identical conditions. This isolates the individual contribution of every intervention and identifies which mechanism resolves which failure mode, rather than reporting only the performance of the final architecture. All variants are evaluated on the stratified test set, which was held out from training in every configuration reported in this paper, including the final merged-corpus runs of Section 5.3 . Evaluation uses a common metric ensemble: RMSE (pixel-wise geometric error), PSNR and SSIM (structural gradients and luminance), and FID (distributional realism), complemented by qualitative inspection. To select a representative reference case, baseline predictions were ranked by error. The highest-error 5% tail was excluded, as those cases correspond to the pathological, sparsely-sampled operating points of Section 5.4 ; the reference sample, Flame ID 1736, was drawn from the next 5% band and held fixed throughout the ablation. Inspection was extended to the 50 highest-error predictions, beyond which no visible degradation appeared. GAN ablations are trained for 500 epochs and DDPM ablations for 1k epochs to isolate architectural effects.
blocks.zh: 这两种范式都是通过一个通融研究来开发的:从一个简单的有条件的基准开始,第3和4节中引入的物理约束一次被添加一个,每个中间模型在相同的条件下被重新训练并重新评价. 这孤立了每个干预的个人贡献并确定了哪种机制解决了哪种失败模式,而不是只报告最终架构的绩效. 所有变体均在分级测试中进行评估,测试是在本文所报告的每个配置的培训中进行的,包括第5.3节的最后合并-公司运行。 评价使用一个通用的计量组合:RMSE(像素偏上几何误差)、PSNR和SSIM(结构梯度和亮度)和FID(分配现实主义),辅以质量检查。 为了选择具有代表性的参考案例,基线预测按错误排序。 不包括最高的5%尾巴,因为这些病例与第5.4节的病理操作点相对应;参考样本 " Flame ID 1736 " 从下5%的波段抽取,并在整个衰竭期间固定。 检查范围扩大到50个最高误差的预测,此后没有出现明显的退化。 为500个世纪培训了GAN活化剂,为1克活化剂培训了DDPM活化剂,以隔离建筑效果。

blocks.en: 5.1 cLSGAN Ablation
blocks.zh: 5.1 cLSGAN 读取

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the adversarial progression. The late-conditioned cGAN baseline attains a favourable FID (50.86) but collapses conditionally, largely ignoring the requested operating point (local RMSE 0.128 on the reference flame). Broadcasting the 15 features onto the input grid locks the macroscopic geometry (RMSE 0.041) at the cost of pronounced checkerboard textures (FID 89.61). Switching to the least-squares objective stabilizes the minimax gradients but cannot alone restore texture, whereas CBN without any spatial constraint produces the opposite failure: photorealistic turbulence (FID 31.97) that drifts freely across the canvas (RMSE 0.057), since its affine modulation carries no positional information. The L1 anchor is the decisive step, driving RMSE to 0.029 and PSNR to 35.58, although direct concatenation still leaves horizontal structural artifacts (FID 50.67). Combining the anchor with CBN reconciles both objectives at last—FID 31.65, RMSE 0.028, SSIM 0.965. Replacing the hand-picked weight λ L ​ 1 = 100 \lambda_{L1}=100 with dynamic EMA balancing then yields the best perceptual score of the study (FID 30.98) at practically identical geometric accuracy; its principal value, however, is methodological, as it removes the human-tuned hyperparameter and thus any implicit test-set bias from the training loop.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了对抗性进展。 条件晚的cGAN基线得到有利的FID(50.86),但有条件地崩溃了,基本上忽略了所要求的操作点(参考火焰上的本地RMSE 0128). 将15个功能广播到输入网格上,将宏几何(RMSE 0.041)锁定在显式检查板纹理(FID 89.61)上。 切换到最小平面目标可以稳定最小平面梯度,但单靠它不能恢复纹理,而CBN在没有任何空间限制的情况下会产生相反的失败:光现实主义的扰动(FID 31.97)会自由漂移到帆布上(RMSE0.057),因为其外缘调制没有位置信息. L1锚是决定性的一步,驱动RMSE为0.029,而PSNR为35.58,尽管直接接合仍然会留下横向结构文物(FID 50.67). 将主播与CBN合并,最终调和了两个目标——FID 31.65,RMSE 0.028,SSIM 0.965. 以动态EMA平衡取代手工选取的分量QQL 1 = 100\lambda_{L1}=100,然后以几乎完全相同的几何精度得出研究中的最佳能见分数(FID 30.98);但是,其主要价值是方法性,因为它取消了人调高参数,从而从训练循环中消除了任何隐含的测试偏差。

blocks.en: 5.2 DDPM Ablation and Truncated Inference
blocks.zh: 5.2 DDPM 偏差和断断推论

blocks.en: Table 3 charts the diffusion progression. The vanilla conditional DDPM (Model A) fails catastrophically on sparse imagery (RMSE 0.135, FID 153.26), drifting across the canvas and hallucinating background artifacts. The luminance-masked objective (Model B) halves the RMSE to 0.065; CoordConv (Model C) eliminates blank-tensor and drifting-flame failure modes (RMSE 0.048); and EMA weights (Model D) yield the best structural configuration (RMSE 0.040, SSIM 0.903). Throughout, FID worsens (peaking at 202.47) as generative capacity is bottlenecked toward geometry—a persistent grain that motivates intervening on the sampler rather than the network. Halting stochastic injection at t trunc = 150 t_{\mathrm{trunc}}=150 (Table 3 ) collapses the FID from 202.47 to 57.84 while further improving RMSE to 0.036 and SSIM to 0.936, with no retraining.

blocks.en: 5.3 Final Models on the Merged Corpus
blocks.zh: 5.3 合并公司的最后模型

blocks.en: With every architectural and weighting choice locked during ablation, the training and validation sets are merged to maximize information density, and both finalized models are retrained (Table 4 ). The cLSGAN-L1-CBN reaches RMSE 0.025 / FID 29.68 at 1k epochs, and a further 1k epochs improve the aggregate metrics to RMSE 0.022 / FID 20.68. This numerical gain, however, does not translate into the targeted qualitative improvement: although individual predictions can sharpen locally—as on the reference flame (Fig. 3 , first two columns)—the two checkpoints produce nearly identical outputs over most of the test set, and the specific limitation that motivated the extended run—internal fields that occasionally remain rigid or segmented, with textures that are not always fully realistic—persists essentially unchanged at 2k epochs. Prolonging training confirms this saturation: at 4k epochs the test-set RMSE degrades to 0.024. Extended adversarial training thus redistributes error within the low-frequency structure the metrics reward most, rather than deepening the generator’s representation of the underlying flame physics; the high-frequency texture deficit is intrinsic to single-step adversarial mapping on sparse fluid data and is not resolved by training duration alone. The DDPM behaves differently: because a fresh noise tensor and random timestep are drawn at every forward pass, the network effectively never sees the same input twice and is strongly insulated against memorization. It overtakes the adversarial surrogate in geometric accuracy by 10k epochs (RMSE 0.021 versus 0.022) and reaches RMSE 0.019 / FID 20.29 / PSNR 38.33 at 40k epochs, beyond which loss tracking indicates incipient overfitting and training is halted. Qualitatively (Figs. 3 and 4 , with the corresponding operating parameters in Table 5 ), the 40K-epoch DDPM renders smooth, continuous thermodynamic gradients that the single-step generator cannot replicate (local RMSE 0.0169 on the challenging reference flame). In terms of latency, the two paradigms remain sharply differentiated: the GAN synthesizes an image in a single forward pass in about 20 ms, three orders of magnitude faster than the full 1k-step reverse diffusion chain, which requires roughly thirty seconds per sample on the same hardware.
blocks.zh: 由于每个建筑和加权选择在衰减期间都锁定,培训和验证组合被合并,以尽量扩大信息密度,两个最终完成的模型都经过再培训(表4)。 cLSGAN-L1-CBN在一克时达到RMSE 0.025 / FID 29.68,再有一克时改进了总的度量衡为RMSE 0.022 / FID 20.68. 然而,这一数值增长并没有转化为目标明确的质量改进:虽然个别预测可以使当地——如同参考火焰(图3,前两栏)——两个检查站在大多数测试组中产出几乎相同,而且具体的限制促使扩大运行——内部领域有时僵硬或分化,而纹理并不总是完全现实——在2千个时段基本上保持不变。 长时间的训练证实了这种饱和性:在4克时,测试集RMSE降解为0.024. 因此,扩大对抗训练在低频结构中重新分配误差,衡量标准最有益处,而不是加深发电机对基本火焰物理的反映;高频纹理不足是稀有流体数据单步对抗绘图的内在因素,不能仅靠训练时间来解决。 DDPM的表现不同:因为每个前行路口都画出新鲜的噪声收发器和随机分出的时间步,所以网络实际上从未两次看到同样的输入并强烈地绝缘于记忆. 它在几何精确度上将对抗性替代物取而代之的是10千个纪元(RMSE 0.021对0.022),并在40千个纪元上达到RMSE 0.019 / FID 20.29 / PSNR 38.33,超过这些纪元后,损失跟踪显示刚起步的过度适应并停止了训练. 定性(图3和图4,表5中相应的操作参数),40K-epoch DDPM使单步发电机无法复制的平滑连续热力学梯度(在挑战性参考火焰上为RMSE 0.0169). 在耐久性方面,两个范式仍然有显著的区别:GAN在一次前传中以大约20毫秒的速度合成出一幅图像,比完整的一克步倒向扩散链快出三个数量级,同一硬件上每个样本需要约30秒.

blocks.en: 5.4 Persistent Outliers and Physical Sensitivity Validation
blocks.zh: 5.4 持久性外部和物理敏感性验证

blocks.en:
Across the ablations of both paradigms, a small subset of test conditions consistently remained among the poorest predictions, with errors of nearly constant magnitude regardless of architecture or training horizon, consistent with the observation of Section 5 that visible degradation is confined to the top 50 highest-error cases. A nearest-neighbour analysis in the standardized 15-dimensional parameter space showed that these conditions lie in sparsely populated regions of the operational envelope, at unusually large distances from their closest training samples. Three non-mutually-exclusive factors plausibly contribute. First, coverage: with fewer than one thousand training conditions over fifteen dimensions, isolated operating points—particularly those adjacent to aerodynamic bifurcations—offer no informative neighbours from which to interpolate. Second, ground truth quality: a few reference frames carry optical acquisition artefacts, so part of the measured error penalizes imperfections of the target rather than of the prediction. Third, path dependence of the physical system: swirl-stabilized flames can exhibit hysteresis, whereby the same set of operating parameters corresponds to different stable flame topologies depending on the trajectory followed through the parameter space to reach that condition [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] . Since the acquisition history is not part of the 15-dimensional input, such conditions define a multi-valued target that no deterministic conditional mapping can resolve, and the associated error is irreducible by construction.
These persistent outliers therefore characterize the data—its sparsity and its possible path dependence—rather than a deficiency of the learned mapping, and they delimit the confidence envelope within which the surrogate should be trusted.
To verify that the models capture the governing physics rather than memorizing the corpus—a legitimate concern once training and validation sets are merged—a sensitivity study was conducted: input vectors were perturbed by small increments along individual operating variables and the generated images inspected. The synthesized topologies evolved gradually, with flame length, radial expansion, and lift-off height responding in the directions expected from swirl-stabilized combustion, rather than snapping onto the nearest training image. Both surrogates therefore interpolate the underlying dynamics of the operational envelope instead of behaving as nearest-neighbour retrieval, supporting their use for exploring unseen conditions.
blocks.zh:
在整个两种模式中,少数测试条件始终属于最贫穷的预测,无论结构或培训范围如何,其误差几乎保持不变,这符合第5节的意见,即明显的退化仅限于前50个最恶劣的病例。 对标准化15维参数空间的近邻分析表明,这些条件位于业务信封中人口稀少的地区,离其最近的训练样本相去甚远。 三个非相互排斥的因素有合理的贡献。 首先,覆盖面:在15个维度以上的训练条件不足1 000个的情况下,孤立的操作点——特别是那些与空气动力活化器相邻的操作点——没有信息化的邻居可以插出。 第二,地面真实性:少数参考框架携带了光学获取工艺品,因此所测量出的部分错误会惩罚目标而非预测的不完善. 第三,物理系统对路径的依赖性:螺旋稳定火焰可以表现出歇斯底里,即同一组操作参数对应不同的稳定火焰地貌,这取决于通过参数空间所遵循的轨迹,从而达到这种状态[17,18,19]. 由于获取历史不属于15维输入,因此这种条件定义了一个无法确定条件的绘图所能解决的多值目标,而相关的出错是无法被构建所减少的.
因此,这些持续存在的异常点是数据的特点——它的伸缩性及其可能的道路依赖性——而不是所学地图的不足,它们划定了应信任代孕者的信任信封。
为了核实这些模型能够捕捉到支配性物理,而不是对生物体的记忆——一旦培训和鉴定组合合并,这是正当的关切——开展了一项敏感性研究:输入矢量因单个操作变量和所检查的生成图像的少量增量而受到影响。 被合成的地貌逐渐演化出来,火焰长度,射线扩张,升起高度在从螺旋稳定燃烧所预期的方向响应,而不是被分解到最近的训练图像上. 因此,这两个代用词对业务信封的基本动态进行内插,而不是作为近邻检索,支持将其用于探索看不见的条件。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: This work demonstrated that generative AI can serve as a visual surrogate for oxy-combustion flames despite a corpus of only 1,609 samples. Its central practical outcome is a redefined burner development workflow: instead of multi-day rig campaigns, an engineer adjusts the 15 operating parameters and immediately visualizes flame length, radial expansion, and lift-off. This shift shortens development time, multiplies the number of candidate designs explored within a given budget, and reserves scarce facility time and pure oxygen for the final validation of the most promising configurations.
blocks.zh: 这项工作表明,尽管只有1,609个样本,但基因AI可以作为氧燃烧火焰的视觉代用物。 它的核心实际成果是重新定义了燃烧器的开发工作流程:一个工程师不进行多日钻机运动,而是调整了15个操作参数,并立即可视化了火焰长度,射线扩张,升起. 这一转变缩短了开发时间,使在特定预算范围内探索的候选设计数量相乘,并为最有希望的配置的最终验证保留了稀缺的设施时间和纯氧.

blocks.en: Reproducing flame images under limited data required custom models accounting for physical constraints: for the adversarial route, early spatial conditioning, a projection discriminator, LSGAN gradients, CBN modulation, and a dynamically balanced L1 anchor resolved the perception–distortion trade-off; for the diffusion route, the same role was played by a luminance-weighted reconstruction objective, absolute coordinate awareness, EMA stabilization, and truncated deterministic sampling. The finalized DDPM achieves the best geometric accuracy and perceptual realism of the study (RMSE 0.019, FID 20.29, PSNR 38.33, SSIM 0.973) and, unlike the adversarial surrogate—whose metric gains under prolonged training leave its characteristic texture-realism deficit uncorrected and eventually reverse in geometric accuracy—benefits from long training horizons, at the cost of an iterative sampling loop of roughly thirty seconds per image on a mobile workstation GPU, three orders of magnitude slower than the adversarial surrogate, which remains the choice for strictly interactive use, generating in about 20 ms on the same hardware. Residual errors concentrate in sparse regions of the operational envelope, with flame-topology hysteresis as a further candidate explanation, while the models respond smoothly and physically to perturbed inputs rather than memorizing the corpus. Future work could address accelerated diffusion samplers (e.g., DDIM-style schedules) to close the latency gap, a principled selection of the DDPM reconstruction weights—the luminance-mask amplitude and the fixed coefficient of Eq. (4), which could be balanced dynamically as for the adversarial L1 anchor—uncertainty quantification near aerodynamic bifurcations, targeted acquisition in the identified sparse regions, and extension to time-resolved flame dynamics.
blocks.zh: 在有限的数据下再生火焰图像需要考虑到物理限制的定制模型:用于对抗路线、早期空间调节、投影歧义、LSGAN梯度、CBN调制,以及动态平衡的L1锚点解决了感知-扭曲取舍;对于扩散路线来说,同样的作用是具有亮度加权的重建目标、绝对协调意识、EMA稳定化和断断定性取样。 最终完成的DDPM实现了研究的最佳几何精度和感知现实性(RMSE 0.019, FID 20.29, PSNR 38.33, SSIM 0.973),并且与对抗性代用方法不同——在长期训练下,其特征的纹理-现实性缺陷得不到纠正,最终在几何精度方面出现反差——在移动工作站GPU上以每幅图像大约30秒的迭接取样循环为代价,比对抗性代用方法慢出三个等分级,后者仍然是严格交互使用的选择,在同一硬件上产生大约20毫秒的精度. 残余误差集中在业务信封的稀有区域,以火焰-地貌歇斯底里为另一种备选解释,而模型则对扰动输入作出平稳和物理的反应,而不是对体积进行记忆。 今后的工作可以涉及加速扩散采样器(例如DDIM式时间表)以缩小延迟差距、原则性选择DDPM重建权重——光线-掩体振幅和Eq.(4)的固定系数,这可以像对抗力L1锚地一样动态地平衡——空气动力双发附近不确定的量化,在已查明的稀有区域有针对性地获取,并延伸到时间解析的火焰动力。
